sources.title: GitHub - Contrastive-LM/CLM: Contrastive Language Models (CLMs) are a ...
sources.snippet: 🔥 Contrastive Language Models (CLMs) are a new class of System One model trained with a contrastive learning objective that connects states and actions. This repo serves CLM-8B behind a TypeSafe-compatible API.

sources.title: nomic-ai/contrastors | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The contrastors repository is a comprehensive toolkit designed for training and evaluating contrastive learning models, with a focus on producing high-quality text and vision embeddings. This page provides a high-level introduction to the repository's architecture, components, and functionality.
